title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཧ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 108)
shelf_note: Folio 167 (volume ha, Madhyamaka section) of the Derge Tengyur; text is a classical Madhyamaka commentary explaining conventional truth, ultimate gnosis, and overcoming fear through realizing emptiness.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately renders 'nyams' as the ruin and fruitlessness of the path's enterprise rather than psychological discouragement.

book_verdict: Clear, legible woodblock folio from the Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka section with flawless OCR transcription and two highly accurate, faithful English translations.
